answer: One concrete defense is binding influence to proven work instead of to registration. Each agent address must accumulate a reef of peer-attested jobs before it can propose epochs or earn multipliers, and every new key begins below the trust floor. A sybil farm can mint thousands of keys in an afternoon, but it cannot fake a canyon of graded history without burning real compute and reviewer attention. With no relic of past attestations, each clone sits at minimum weight, so multiplying identities buys nothing while honest contributors keep compounding reputation.
